acceptance_criteria: Edition, servicing branch and ESU are validated; EOL releases and Windows 10 Home/Pro are refused; a release inside 90 days of end of support warns.
test_evidence: PlatformSupportTests (14 cases)

requirement: Self-hosted Windows service/API for shared multi-user work
acceptance_criteria: A customer-hosted service exposes authenticated workspace, assessment, plan, approval and monitoring endpoints over HTTPS.
test_evidence: Customer-hosted ASP.NET Core service exposes tenant-scoped assessment, plan, approval, audit and membership endpoints behind Entra JWT validation; startup fails closed without authority/audience or HTTPS. 16 API tests via WebApplicationFactory.

acceptance_criteria: The service persists to SQL Server (or another justified relational store) with a migration path from SQLite.
test_evidence: Provider selected by configuration (SQLite/SQL Server) and schema created by a committed EF Core migration; 43 service tests run on the migrated SQLite schema, including idempotent initialization. Tests: MigrationTests, CollaborationStoreTests. SQL Server has not been run against an instance and there is no SQLite-to-SQL Server data copy tool.

acceptance_criteria: Every tenant, action, export and approval is authorised on the server; a client-supplied tenant id cannot cross boundaries.
test_evidence: Membership is resolved from the store on every request; every query filters by tenant; a body-supplied tenant id cannot cross tenants; 403 on no membership or insufficient role. Covered by API and store tests.

acceptance_criteria: Optimistic concurrency prevents two operators overwriting a plan or approval.
test_evidence: Optimistic concurrency stamps on memberships, plans and approvals; a stale If-Match returns 409. Covered by the stale-stamp API test and the concurrency store test.

acceptance_criteria: Approvals and the hash-chained audit log are shared across clients and survive a client reinstall.
test_evidence: Approvals are durable across service restarts and bound to the plan hash; the shared audit is a per-tenant SHA-256 chain with a verify endpoint and tamper detection. Covered by store and API tests.

acceptance_criteria: The desktop app still works fully offline on local SQLite when no service is configured.
test_evidence: Offline mode and local SQLite are covered by tests

requirement: Interactive Entra SSO via WAM with browser fallback
acceptance_criteria: Operators sign in with Windows Web Account Manager; a secure browser fallback is used where WAM is unavailable.
test_evidence: InteractiveBrowserCredential exists as a secondary auth mode; MSAL/WAM sign-in and role-scoped sessions are absent.

acceptance_criteria: Viewer, Analyst, Designer, Operator, Approver, Auditor and Application Administrator are mapped from Entra app roles and enforced server-side.
test_evidence: All seven roles and the permission matrix are enforced by the collaboration service; the desktop app still has four local roles and no Entra claim mapping.

requirement: Interactive and automation identities are separate
acceptance_criteria: User SSO and the tenant automation app registration are distinct, with no privilege coupling.
test_evidence: Certificate app-only identity exists; there is no interactive user identity to separate it from.

requirement: Certificate-first lifecycle with 12-month default and overlap rotation
acceptance_criteria: Certificates are the default credential, default to 12 months, warn 30 days before expiry, and rotate by adding and validating a replacement before retiring the old key after a 7-day overlap.
test_evidence: Lifetime states, 30-day lead, long-lifetime acknowledgement, and an ordered rotation plan with a 7-day overlap; the settings rotation button reports the overlap deadline. Tests: CertificateLifecyclePolicyTests, ProvisioningTests. A live key swap still needs a tenant (IDN-02).

requirement: Client secret is an explicit lab fallback only
acceptance_criteria: Secret mode is lab-only, defaults to 12 months, is capped at Entra's 24-month maximum, DPAPI-protected, rotatable and warns before expiry.
test_evidence: Lab-only enforcement, a 12-month default, Entra's 24-month cap, a 14-day rotation warning and expiry handling are tested; provisioning refuses 36 months with a clear message. Tests: ClientSecretPolicyTests, ProvisioningTests.

requirement: Graph permission set matches collector usage
acceptance_criteria: One manifest declares every app-only Graph permission the collectors use, all read-only; provisioning resolves role ids from the tenant's Graph service principal and fails on an unknown permission.
test_evidence: Manifest covers every collector API, is read-only and excludes broad Directory.Read.All; role ids are resolved at runtime and missing roles fail provisioning rather than requesting an invented id. Tests: GraphPermissionManifestTests.

acceptance_criteria: When programmatic consent is unavailable the operator gets a tenant-specific admin-consent link and the exact administrator role needed; no secret is placed in the link.
test_evidence: Commercial and GCC High links, encoded optional redirect, rejected identifiers, a manual consent step after a failed grant and a re-grant link after success. Tests: AdminConsentLinkTests, ProvisioningTests. The live grant itself needs a tenant.

requirement: Immutable, separated, time-bound approvals with configurable quorum
acceptance_criteria: Approvals record actor, stage, time, comment and plan hash; self-approval and duplicate stage approvals are refused; any plan change invalidates approval; a submitted approval expires after seven days; each stage requires a configurable number of distinct approvers.
test_evidence: Per-stage quorum (1-9), duplicate-approver refusal, round reset after a change request, invalid configuration rejection and the default single-approver flow are tested; quorum is persisted in desktop settings and read by the service host from Collaboration:Approval with fail-fast validation. Tests: ApprovalQuorumTests, WorkflowTests, ServiceQuorumTests.

acceptance_criteria: A fresh read-only collection is compared with the snapshot the phase was approved against; any change invalidates the approval and blocks execution.
test_evidence: TenantSnapshotFingerprint covers every drift signal; the phase records its baseline fingerprint at simulation; DeploymentGate blocks without a recheck or on a changed fingerprint; the desktop execute path re-collects and refuses before calling the executor. Tests: DeploymentDriftRecheckTests, PhasedDeploymentTests.

requirement: Irreversible actions are modelled and gated
acceptance_criteria: Legal hold, disposition, deletion and encryption effects are marked non-restorable and require an approved risk exception.
test_evidence: Operations now declare reversible, restorable or irreversible; the gate names irreversible operations and blocks them until risk acceptance, and generated updates are restorable. Tests: IrreversibilityGateTests, PhasedDeploymentTests. Legal hold, disposition and encryption operations do not exist in the catalog yet, so they are not classified.

requirement: Data Map and Unified Catalog coverage
acceptance_criteria: Data sources, scans, collections/domains, data products, lineage and data quality are discovered and assessed.
test_evidence: No Data Map or Unified Catalog workload exists. This is the largest Purview coverage gap.

requirement: Adaptive Protection, Information Barriers, PAM and Data Security Investigations
acceptance_criteria: Each workload has discovery evidence, assessment and honest coverage labels.
test_evidence: None of these workloads is implemented.

requirement: Onboarding wizard, glossary and learning paths
acceptance_criteria: A novice is guided through what/why/prerequisites/role/licence/impact/risk/evidence/recovery with a glossary and labs.
test_evidence: Help topics and a sample tenant exist; no onboarding wizard, glossary page or labs.

acceptance_criteria: An existing tenant is assessed for drift, conflicts and debt with incremental remediation.
test_evidence: Greenfield detection and monitoring drift exist; there is no brownfield onboarding mode.

acceptance_criteria: A decision pack with options, architecture, phases, owners, acceptance criteria, costs and rollback limits is exported.
test_evidence: Change impact covers ten sections. A decision-pack builder now derives Minimum (critical), Recommended (critical/high/medium) and Enhanced (all) scopes, plus phases, module owners, acceptance criteria, licence costs (prices only when supplied) and rollback limits, with a Markdown renderer. Tests: DecisionPackTests. It is not yet wired to a report type or CLI command, so export is not end-to-end.

acceptance_criteria: Each release publishes an SBOM and provenance alongside SHA-256 hashes.
test_evidence: CycloneDX SBOM generated locally (1.7, 106 components); the CLI records version, commit, SBOM digest and SHA-256 of every artefact; CI publishes both. Tests: ReleaseManifestTests. Provenance is not yet signed or attested by a build service.

requirement: Signed plugin manifests with declared permissions
acceptance_criteria: A plugin assembly loads only with a signed manifest that matches its hash, declares a version and requests no permission outside the assessment-read allowlist.
test_evidence: Allowed and unsigned manifests, tampered assembly, out-of-allowlist permission, name/version mismatch, malformed manifest, wrong key and loader rejection are covered. Tests: PluginTrustTests. Publisher key distribution is manual.

requirement: Accessibility review against the implemented XAML
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard, contrast, automation names and screen-reader behaviour are reviewed and evidenced.
test_evidence: Accessibility notes exist in the user guide; no review or automated check is evidenced.

requirement: Per-user SQLite is never described as multi-user
acceptance_criteria: Documentation states that collaboration requires the service, and per-user SQLite is local/offline only.
test_evidence: Recorded as an explicit limitation in the dashboard and README

requirement: Desktop client uses the collaboration service
acceptance_criteria: The WPF app signs in, selects a shared tenant, publishes assessments and plans, and approves through the service instead of local-only storage.
test_evidence: Typed client for identity, assessments, plans, approvals with If-Match, audit and members; eight end-to-end HTTP tests cover role enforcement, staged approval, audit verification and member management. Tests: CollaborationClientTests. The WPF screens still use local services and shared-mode sign-in needs IDN-01.
